title: Terrestrial Energy Inc. 8-K Filing — Executive Officer Employment Agreements
summary: Terrestrial Energy Inc. filed an 8-K current report disclosing new employment agreements with two executive officers: CFO Brian Thrasher (base salary $350,000, target bonus 43%) and COO William Smith (base salary $330,000, target bonus 20%). The company is a small energy development firm trading on Nasdaq as IMSR. This filing is a corporate governance/HR disclosure with no relevance to market structure or macro catalysts.
key_points: Terrestrial Energy Inc. (Nasdaq: IMSR) filed Form 8-K on April 16, 2026 under Item 5.02 (Executive Officer Employment Agreements)
CFO Brian Thrasher's employment agreement specifies base salary of $350,000 and target annual bonus of 43% of base salary
COO William Smith's employment agreement specifies base salary of $330,000 and target annual bonus of 20% of base salary
Both agreements include severance provisions, restrictive covenants (non-competition and non-solicitation), and equity award eligibility under the 2025 Plan
Company is incorporated in Delaware (IRS ID: 98-1785406) with principal offices in Charlotte, NC
Company also has redeemable warrants trading as IMSRW at $11.50 per share
